name: MMSD Storm Update news posts (per-event overflow volume, 5-day letter to WDNR)
waters_covered: Milwaukee, Menomonee and Kinnickinnic Rivers, Milwaukee harbor and Lake Michigan; MMSD separate-sewer area
access_detail: News post per event under /about-us/news/; fetched raw/mmsd-storm-update-2026-08-01.html. No RSS (/about-us/news/rss 404). Posts link a "5-day letter" PDF and the CSO impacted-waters map.

sample_record.title: MMSD Storm Update August 1st, 2026
sample_record.text: MMSD is reporting the following information ( see 5-day letter ) to the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources regarding a combined sewer overflow that took place on August 1, 2026. Overflow Volume: 8/1/26 - Overflow volume of 96 million gallons.

cadence: Posted with the 5-day letter: the 2026-08-01 overflow was posted 2026-08-06.
history: Posts back to at least 2006 (search); 2026 had 2,714 million gallons through April (2026OverflowVolumesVertical042426.pdf).
status_reason: Dated, event-level public record for the state's largest CSO system, but HTML posts about 5 days after the event with no outfall detail.
notes: Annual overflow volumes 1994-2026 in raw/mmsd-2026-overflow-volumes.txt (2025: 5,140 MG; 2024: 357 MG).

name: MMSD Milwaukee Rain & Facility Information page (live year-to-date gallons overflowed)
access_detail: Fetched: "2026 MMSD VOLUME TREATED Gallons Treated: 36,135,000,000 Gallons Overflowed: 2,810,937,528 ... This page is automatically updated. The data have not been verified and may contain errors."
status_reason: A change in "Gallons Overflowed" is a same-day signal that an overflow is under way; snapshot it.

name: MMSD Combined Sewer Overflow Public Notification Plan (July 16, 2018)
access_detail: Downloaded (4.7 MB; text layer kept as raw/mmsd-cso-pn-plan.txt, PDF not kept). Only pages 1-2 have a text layer; sections 6 Notice to Governments and 7 Public Notice are images and were not read.

name: MMSD Water Drop Alert (text WATERDROP to 414-296-4422)
access_detail: SMS sign-up; MMSD says alerts are also shared on social media and the rain/facility page.
status_reason: A pre-storm "use less water" alert, not an overflow notice; useful as a lead indicator only.

name: Wis. Admin. Code NR 210.21 sanitary sewer and treatment facility overflows (reporting and public notification)
access_detail: docs.legis.wisconsin.gov reset the connection (curl) and returned 503 (WebFetch) on 2026-11-03; text taken from WDNR form instructions and search snippets.
status_reason: Public notice duty for every SSO and TFO, "promptly", by the "most effective and efficient communications available in the community"; no web channel or deadline in hours.

name: WDNR SSO/TFO report form 3400-184 and instructions (Switchboard)
access_detail: Downloaded raw/ssoform-instructions.pdf. Quotes: "Initial notification to the Department is required within 24 hours of the event." "All overflows (SSOs & TFOs) are required to be public noticed according to s. NR 210.21(5), Wis. Adm. Code. Notification shall occur according to a facility's emergency response plan in their CMOM and occur promptly after any overflow event. The notification level should correlate to the extent of risk to the public. At a minimum, if an overflow is to a surface water, a daily newspaper of general circulation shall be notified." Report within 5 business days through Switchboard.
status_reason: The form records the public-notice date and method, so WDNR holds the data; it is not published.

name: WDNR Sanitary Sewer Overflow reporting page
access_detail: Fetched; no public list, map or download of reported overflows.
status_reason: Submission instructions only; Switchboard is a permittee login. No WDNR public overflow data found.

name: EPA SOBE event tables, Wisconsin permits

name: 40 CFR 122.38 (Great Lakes Basin CSO notice) for MMSD and Superior
status_reason: Both Wisconsin CSO permits discharge to the Great Lakes Basin (Lake Michigan; St. Louis Bay of Lake Superior): 4-hour electronic public notice.

name: City of Superior Sewage Disposal System CSO notification
access_detail: Web search found no City notice page; WPR/KSTP report overflows at Superior and Ashland in news.
status_reason: No public channel found for a Great Lakes CSO permittee that owes a 4-hour notice; needs a direct look at the City site and social accounts.

name: Municipal SSO public notices on city websites (Fremont-Orihula-Wolf River, Hortonville, Fox Crossing, Menomonie, Stoughton Utilities, Oconomowoc Utilities, Fennimore, Town of Greenville)

status_reason: Proves notices exist on the web, scattered across hundreds of municipal sites; not worth individual ingesters.
